# Provider capability matrix — OpenAI Responses API readiness (evidence, 2026-08-21)

Toolchain pinned by this checkout: **pydantic-ai-slim 1.107.2**, **openai SDK 2.53.0**. All
file:line citations are against worktree `work-b612` at `origin/main` (post-6fb4d801c9). Probe
transcripts were produced in this worktree's `.venv` interpreter.

## The matrix

Classification key: **Responses-ready** = a real `OpenAIResponsesModel` construction path exists
under the pin AND rebar could route to it after the (named) rebar-side unblocks;
**Chat-Completions-only** = the pin offers no Responses construction path for this row, so vendor
capability is moot for the migration; **UNKNOWN** = evidence missing, named per row.

| # | Endpoint / row | Status | Evidence (cited, not inferred) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hosted OpenAI via `openai:` / `openai-chat:` (no `base_url`; delegated to pydantic-ai `infer_provider`) | **Responses-ready** (rebar-blocked today — see constraints) | Probe: `infer_model("openai-responses:gpt-4o")` constructs `OpenAIResponsesModel` + `OpenAIProvider` under 1.107.2. Probe: `infer_model("openai:gpt-4o")` emits `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning`: "In v2.0, 'openai:' will resolve to the OpenAI Responses API by default." Contract tests (`tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py`) pass identically for structured-output, streaming, tool-call, 429-retry and base-URL routing under both prefixes against the two wire protocols. |
| 2 | Custom `base_url` OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM/LiteLLM recipe) via `ProviderSession._build_openai` | **Chat-Completions-only** (in rebar, by construction) | `providers.py:105-106`: the builder is registered only under `"openai"`/`"openai-chat"`; `providers.py:153`: the per-candidate endpoint interpose is keyed on the same two names. A `openai-responses:` string never reaches `_build_openai`, so `base_url` would be ignored → the row cannot be Responses-ready without a rebar change. Whether any given local server implements `/v1/responses` is a separate vendor question → see UNKNOWN row 8. |
| 3 | Per-candidate `endpoint` override (fallback chains, task cc33, `ProviderSession.model_for`) | **Chat-Completions-only** (same keying) | `providers.py:150-155`: `endpoint_override` registers `_build_openai` only for `{"openai", "openai-chat"}`. |
| 4 | `gateway/openai:` (Pydantic AI Gateway) | **Chat-Completions-only** under the pin | Probe: `infer_model("gateway/openai:gpt-4o")` (with `PYDANTIC_AI_GATEWAY_BASE_URL` set) constructs `OpenAIChatModel`. 1.107.2 exposes no `gateway/openai-responses` prefix in `known_model_names()`. |
| 5 | `deepseek:` | **Chat-Completions-only** under the pin | Probe: constructs `OpenAIChatModel` + `DeepSeekProvider`. No Responses construction path exists for the prefix in 1.107.2. |
| 6 | `grok:`, `moonshotai:`, `heroku:` | **Chat-Completions-only** under the pin | Probe: each constructs `OpenAIChatModel` (+ `GrokProvider`/`MoonshotAIProvider`/`HerokuProvider`). Same reasoning as row 5. |
| 7 | `cerebras:` | **Chat-Completions-only** under the pin | Probe: constructs `CerebrasModel`, which 1.107.2 implements as an OpenAI-chat-protocol model; no Responses path for the prefix. |
| 8 | `xai:`, `groq:` | **UNKNOWN (construction untestable here)** | Probe: both raise `ImportError` — the `xai-sdk` / `groq` optional packages are not installed in this checkout and are not in rebar's extras (`pyproject.toml` ships only `[openai]`, `[bedrock]`, `[google]`). Missing evidence: the constructed model class under those extras. Note `groq:` uses `GroqModel` (its own protocol), and `xai:` the xai-sdk — neither plausibly OpenAI-Responses, but that is inference, so the row stays UNKNOWN. |
| 9 | Vendor-side native `/v1/responses` support (DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, Cerebras, Moonshot, Heroku, LMStudio, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM) | **UNKNOWN — and moot for 155c under the pin** | Missing evidence: vendor API documentation for each. Deliberately not researched: pydantic-ai 1.107.2 offers no third-party Responses construction path (rows 4-8), so vendor capability cannot change the migration decision until upstream adds one. Recorded so a future pin bump knows to re-ask. |

## Production-construction constraints (the `155c` edit-set, cited)

Four rebar code sites make `openai-responses:` unusable today even though pydantic-ai itself
constructs it (each verified by probe in this worktree):

1. **`src/rebar/llm/config.py:210-236` — `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` lacks `openai-responses`.**
   Probe: `split_provider_qualifier("openai-responses:gpt-4o")` → `(None, 'openai-responses:gpt-4o')`
   — the string is treated as an unqualified bare model name, so provider inference fails.
2. **`src/rebar/llm/providers.py` (`_pydantic_ai_known_providers`) — derived from
   `known_model_names()`, which has NO `openai-responses:` entries in 1.107.2** (probe: `False`),
   so `ProviderSession.is_resolvable("openai-responses")` → `False`, and `runner.py:406-411`
   then routes to `provider_factory(_provider_name)`, which "always raises `LLMConfigError`".
   Net effect: `model = "openai-responses:gpt-4o"` is a hard config error in rebar's runner,
   not a lazy delegation — even though bare `pydantic_ai.models.infer_model` accepts it.
   (Upstream's `infer_provider` special-cases the name the same way it does the deprecated
   `google-gla` aliases rebar already compensates for via `_DEPRECATED_PROVIDER_ALIASES`.)
3. **`src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:417-425` — `_PROFILE_RESOLVERS` has no `openai-responses`
   key.** Probe: `capabilities_for("openai-responses:gpt-4o")` degrades to
   `native_structured_output=False` (vs `True` for `openai-chat:gpt-4o`) — a silent
   structured-output downgrade (PromptedOutput instead of NativeOutput) if resolution were
   fixed without this map.
4. **The `openai:` → `openai-chat:` normalizers hard-code the Chat pin:**
   `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:199-200` (`_pai_model`) and
   `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py:246-269` (`_resolve_target`, which also unifies the
   `openai`/`openai-chat` qualifier family). A default flip must revisit both, or `openai:`
   strings will keep resolving to Chat regardless of any new default.

Also relevant for 155c: `ProviderSession._build_openai`'s `_RebarOpenAICompatibleProvider`
withdraws `supports_json_schema_output` for opaque base_url endpoints (providers.py, story S4
AC5) — a Responses-capable custom endpoint would need an equivalent decision, since the
Responses API's structured-output path differs.

## Behavioural diff instrument

`tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py` (landed with this ticket) parameterizes identical
assertions over `openai-chat:` / `openai-responses:` — construction dispatch, custom-base-URL
routing (`/v1/chat/completions` vs `/v1/responses`), structured output, streaming, tool calls,
and the 429 retry surface. Current diff result: **all 12 cases pass under both prefixes**; the
one measured invariant worth naming is that the retry lives in the openai SDK
(`AsyncOpenAI` `max_retries=2` → exactly 3 wire requests before `ModelHTTPError(429)`) and is
identical across both APIs. Re-run after any pin bump: `pytest tests/unit/test_openai_responses_contract.py`.
